name: @wiltech-labs/ngx-styles
description: Shared Sass partials for the Wiltech house look (Ink & Signal) — breakpoints, spacing scale, and design-system mixins (page-title, panel, list, badge, banner, focus-ring, ...) that read --mat-sys-* tokens — plus the Wiltech Labs logo and favicons. Raw .scss and static assets, no compile step.
